comment: I've never been one who likes history classes, but Professor Wray had a way of making the class interesting and exciting. She opened my eyes to see history thru a new lense, giving it depth from all perspectives. Professor Wray's lecturing style was so thorough that I could see in my mind's eye everything that she described. Best professor ever!!

Prof Wray was a treat to have. She does ask for a lot of note taking, but if you keep up with her you have good information to pass the exams. She is very thoughtful and may even make you dinner if you are a student through the SPCS. She is very special. If you work hard, participate in class, and read the assignments you will do great!!!  Gem!!

Prof Wray was one of the toughest teachers that I've ever had, but her classes were incredibly interesting.  I worked very hard in this class for my grade and never thought that it was easy.  Rewarding, yes, but not easy.
She's a tough cookie. Incredibly knowledgeable, a walking encyclopedia. A great teacher with tough and thoughtful assignments.
She is a delightful professor with encyclopedic knowledge.  Take plenty of notes and you will be prepared for the test.  If not don't expect to find the answers elsewhere.

She is great.  She is not hard, but you have to do some work as she is not Easy A anymore.  That being said, a B is a joke to get in her class.  She is super sweet and very friendly.  I would take her again
Delightful!  I came out of each class excited and energized to learn more.
A walking encyclopedia

Took Prof Wray for the 2nd time, as a senior (1st as a freshman) and she's def. added more of a workload. I think it makes it even easier though, because before I didn't even know what I needed to be doing. She's super nice and understanding... Its easy to get an A (I turned in a paper a week late and got a 95). Sometimes boring, but super sweet
Dr. Wray is awesome. If you are interested in history, take her class. She is interesing, caring, and enjoyable. After graduation, I missed her more than any other professor.
I really enjoyed her class!  The kep is attendance and A LOT of note taking!  She is very knowledgable.  So, if you listen and take a lot of notes, you'll do GREAT!
Such a Sweetheart. You don't need to spend money on any texts, there all on blackboard or in her lectures. Interesting course and a great Westhampton lady teaching it.

She's a cool person and she's got a lot of interesting stories. However, she's really boring most of the time. And getting an A is definitely do-able, but she's not "Easy A Wray" anymore. She was put on academic probation for giving too many A's... but she's still easy for how little work you have to do.

I u like history, take her. If u don't, avoid the mistake. She knows her stuff, but this did not make this class was lessboring. Each class there were at least 5 people sleeping. She talks too much (She will not stop talking) and many times I could not tell what was important and what was not.

She definitely lectures but she's worth listening to. I really loved this format for history because it was like being told a story (however, she felt compelled mid-semester to make us do "group worK" which was admittedly painful.) She's a fair grader, just take her class semi seriously and you're fine.

Sitting through her endless lecturing with no class discussion was torture. Inmates should have to spend their sentence in her class. She comes off as relaxed and then tears your projects apart. Rambles endlessly off topic. I would NEVER take another class with her!

Very sweet lady, loves history... Class extremely boring to sit through... and you're never quite sure exactly what's going on... very knowledgable and passionate about history, and will often slip into a ramble of EVERYTHING she knows about a certain topic... Very nice.. I never read or opened a book in the class and got a B. Easy class 4 his. req
While many say she is boring if you are intersted in history you should take her. She obviously knows her stuff and can make interesting connections between historical events

She is really nice and helpful!Beyound doubt she knows her subject and is willing to check your work before you submit it!She is really nice and reminds me of my granny!Take her if you have the chance!
Easy A Wray-the name says it all!
This is my VERY favorite professor; knows her subject beyond a doubt and makes learning FUN!! A role model professor - very much recommended!
She is very animated while teaching!  Fun, hilarious, and challenging!
One of the best professors! Knows her subject, cares about her students.

This lady is one of the nicest you will ever come across. Her classes get more interesting throughout the semester and I can only recommend her to anyone who needs to fulfill their history requirement.
